verdict.rationale: The GST portal's own help pages cover the full core lifecycle online: GST registration (Part A/Part B application, with a step-by-step manual and DSC/EVC verification), filing returns (including uploading invoices via the Offline Tool), and paying tax by generating a Challan and using the Electronic Cash Ledger. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an end-to-end online registration, filing or payment actually completes; the evidence is mostly help-module headings rather than in-depth walkthrough content.
